meta.title: Migrate eBPF for Windows from packages.config to PackageReference NuGet style
meta.body_summary: Migrate eBPF for Windows NuGet packages from packages.config to PackageReference format, claiming build performance improvements and dependency management simplification.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot NuGet migration from packages.config to PackageReference; maintainer Alan-Jowett reported builds failing twice; after iterative fixes PR was closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 205 changed lines across 14 files, this is a small to medium build system refactor by absolute volume, primarily removing packages.config files and updating scripts. As a build performance PR it was closed after repeated build failures, consistent with the outcome.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer Alan-Jowett twice reported that builds were failing after Copilot's migration; Copilot provided iterative fixes for initialization script, sample project paths, and CI cache, but PR was closed without merge.
review_details.performance_claim: NuGet PackageReference migration improves build performance (package restore speed, reduced repository size) and simplifies dependency management.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer reported build failures twice; after two rounds of fixes, PR was closed; no further merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Build system migration involving NuGet format, CI cache configuration, and multiple scripts proved challenging; Copilot could not achieve a successful build after two iterations, indicating a gap in handling complex build infrastructure.

detection_detail.code_reading: No explicit code reading review recorded.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Maintainer reported build failures, indicating CI validation was used to detect issues.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or before/after build timing data provided; only narrative claims about improved build performance and dependency management.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After two rounds of build failure reports and attempted fixes, maintainer closed the PR without merging; no further fix-in-pr occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Migrate eBPF-for-Windows projects from packages.config to PackageReference format: remove packages.config files, add PackageReference entries in Directory.Build.props and individual project files, update scripts and CI cache configuration to use NuGet PackageReference conventions.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Much of the line deletion is from removing legacy packages.config files and clearing references to the old packages directory.
change_trajectory: Core PackageReference migration applied; packages.config files removed, PackageReference entries added.
Build dependencies and project files updated (wdk.props, sample.vcxproj).
First build failure: Copilot fixed initialization script and sample project references.
Second build failure: Copilot fixed CI cache configuration and removed legacy package paths.
PR closed by maintainer after two rounds of unsuccessful fixes.

review_signals.summary: Reported that builds are failing and asked Copilot to investigate and fix.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot provided fixes in subsequent commits.

review_signals.summary: Explained root causes and fixes for first round of build failures.
Repeated that builds are failing after first fixes, asking Copilot to investigate again.
Explained additional fixes for CI cache and legacy package references.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with initial PackageReference migration.
Maintainer Alan-Jowett commented builds failing; Copilot worked and provided fixes.
Maintainer commented again builds still failing; Copilot provided additional fixes.
Maintainer closed PR shortly after second fix attempt.
